title: Lifecycle hook treated its own JSON receipts as source changes
symptom: After JSON entered the public tracked-language set, the integrated HUD test expected a lifecycle PostToolUse receipt with NO_CHANGES but observed PASS because project-local plugin data created BoxBox-owned baseline and receipt JSON inside the source snapshot.

rootCause.summary: Lifecycle snapshots used the repository-wide tracked-extension set without excluding the exact receipt namespace written by the same lifecycle hook. A project-local plugin-data directory therefore made SessionStart evidence appear as a later user JSON edit.

requestedOutcome: Exclude only the current project's BoxBox-owned lifecycle receipt namespace from lifecycle snapshots while continuing to inspect ordinary JSON and unrelated plugin-data JSON; restore NO_CHANGES without weakening source coverage.
decisions: Keep JSON tracked globally and leave snapshot default behavior unchanged.
Pass an explicit exact-directory exclusion only from lifecycleHook, covering all BoxBox sessions for the current project hash.
The final integration check and GLM source audit closed this bounded defect; native host acceptance is tracked separately.

actions.description: Add an optional explicit directory exclusion set to snapshot recursion and use it for the current project's lifecycle-owned receipt namespace.
Verify no self-generated change while ordinary and unrelated plugin-data JSON remain inspected.
Run the final integrated repository check and independent final audit on the frozen candidate.

verification.result: Focused lifecycle and HUD suites passed 9 tests with 57 assertions and no failures; TypeScript and diff checks passed. This does not replace the pending final integrated check or audit.
